chunks: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"The vessels of gold and silver are the possessions"
"of those who do not have certainty."

key_terms.آنِيَةُ: vessels or utensils used for eating and drinking
key_terms.اَلنَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله, the speaker of the hadith
key_terms.اَلْفِضَّةِ: silver, paired with gold in the ruling

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله say about vessels made of gold and silver?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes gold and silver vessels to those lacking certainty, expressing disapproval of attachment to such luxurious utensils. In context, it supports the legal and ethical discouragement surrounding eating and drinking from gold and silver vessels.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4239 - The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said:
"Vessels of gold and silver are the possessions
of those who do not have certainty (in faith)."
